title: Minutes of the Board Meeting held on 8 October 2026

headings.text: Minutes of the Board Meeting held on 8 October 2026
4. Finance report for the third quarter

key_sentences: Apologies were noted as above, and the meeting was quorate.
Income was slightly below budget because three flats remained empty for longer than expected.
Members were reluctant to award a contract of this size without a comparison.
There were fourteen open cases, of which three had been open for more than eight weeks.
The Board agreed to consult members on an increase of 4.5 per cent, which is below the regulatory limit, and to bring the final proposal to the general meeting in December.
The Board asked for its thanks to be passed on to the volunteers.

rows: Joanna Pell (Chair), Marcus Ilunga (Treasurer), Ruth Calloway, Dev Anand Marr, Siobhán Keane, Tomasz Wierzba
Helen Oduya (Chief Officer), Gareth Pryce (Property Manager), Lin Feng (Company Secretary, minutes)
Obtain a second quotation for the Albion Court windows before the contract is awarded.
Write to all tenants of Albion Court with the revised programme and the name of the site contact.
Report the number of open damp and mould cases, with their age, to every Board meeting.
Review the voids policy and propose a target for re-letting time.
Circulate the draft rent-setting paper to members at least four weeks before the general meeting.
Arrange fire-door inspections at Mill Street.
Publish the annual report on the website.
Agree a data-sharing protocol with the local authority for tenancy support referrals.
Recruit two co-opted Board members with financial experience.
Replace the door-entry system at Weavers Yard.
Agree the scope of the stock condition survey with the surveyor.
Update the complaints policy to reflect the new ombudsman code.
Hold a drop-in session for tenants on energy bills.
Test the out-of-hours repairs line and report response times.
Review the bank mandate after the change of Treasurer.
Seek legal advice on the lease of the community room.
Confirm the date of the annual general meeting with the venue.

list_items.text: (ii) to approve a revised repairs budget of £480,000 for the year;
(iii) to ask the Finance Committee to review the voids policy before the December meeting.
(a) a second quotation would be sought from a contractor on the regional framework;
(b) tenants would be told about the delay in writing, and the letter would explain:
(i) the new expected start date of March 2027;
(ii) how to report draughts or broken catches in the meantime;
(c) the Chair and the Treasurer would be authorised to approve the contract between meetings, up to a value of £210,000.
